title: Abstract of the Contents of one of the Ahom Puthis
author: Sir Edward Albert Gait
description: Critical philological abstract of a Tai Ahom palm-leaf manuscript (Puthi) published in the Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal. Contains lexical and syntactic commentary on archaic Tai grammar, historical dates, and vocabulary shared directly with Tai Khamyang and Khamti.
